name: execute_bash
description: Execute a bash command on the system. USE THIS for: curl commands, checking services on private/local networks (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, localhost), running system utilities, checking ports, ping, docker commands, systemctl, etc. When user says 'curl' or asks to check a local/private IP service → use this, NOT mcp_fetch (which only works for public internet URLs). RESTRICTIONS: Cannot modify /home/boss/jarvis-voice (my own code), /etc, ~/.ssh, ~/.gnupg. Cannot run: rm -rf, shutdown, reboot, fork bombs, reverse shells, curl|bash patterns. Read-only access to protected paths is OK.

command.description: The bash command to execute. Cannot modify protected paths like /home/boss/jarvis-voice, /etc, ~/.ssh

working_directory.description: Optional working directory for the command. Cannot be a protected path for write operations.
